title: Ma ke kūlanakauhale
description: Ten short stories about life in the towns of Hawaiʻi: a coffee shop, a flight, a storm, a city meeting, a history walk, a ball game, a wall painting, a ghost tour, a wedding and a lava flow.

lessons.title: Ka hale kope ma ke kikowaena
lessons.summary: Keliʻi runs a small coffee shop near the business centre of Honolulu and buys local coffee from a trader whose family grows it on Kauaʻi.
lessons.text:
He hale kope liʻiliʻi ko Keliʻi ma Honolulu. Aia kona hale kope kokoke i ke kikowaena o ke kūlanakauhale. He nui nā keʻena ma ke kikowaena, a hana nā kānaka he nui ma laila. Makemake lākou a pau i ke kope.

Kūʻai ʻo Keliʻi i kāna kope mai iā Kaʻeo mai. He kālepa ʻo Kaʻeo. Kūʻai aku ke kālepa i ke kope kūloko wale nō. Ulu nā lāʻau kope ma ka ʻāina o kona ʻohana ma Kauaʻi. Mālama ʻo Kaʻeo i nā lāʻau, a lawe ʻo ia i nā hua. Hana ʻia ke kope mai nā hua.

Ma mua o ka wehe ʻana i ka puka, hana ʻo Keliʻi i ke kope. I kēia lā, ua wehe ʻo ia i ka puka o ka hale kope, a ma hope o kekahi manawa pōkole, ua komo mai nā kānaka he nui mai nā keʻena mai. "Wikiwiki!" wahi a kekahi wahine. "Pōkole ka manawa." Ua hana wikiwiki ʻo Keliʻi i ke kope no kēlā me kēia kanaka. ʻEhā kālā ka uku o ke kope. Ua uku ka wahine i ʻehā kālā. "Mahalo!" wahi āna, a ua hele wikiwiki ʻo ia i kona keʻena.

Ma hope, ua hele mai ke kālepa me ke kope hou. Ua uku ʻo Keliʻi iā Kaʻeo no ke kope. "Mahalo nui," wahi a Kaʻeo. "Mahalo nō hoʻi," wahi a Keliʻi. "Makemake nā kānaka a pau i kēia kope kūloko."

Nā nīnau:
Aia ka hale kope o Keliʻi kokoke i ke kikowaena?
ʻAe, aia kona hale kope kokoke i ke kikowaena o ke kūlanakauhale.
He kālepa ʻo Kaʻeo?
ʻAe, he kālepa ʻo ia. Kūʻai aku ʻo ia i ke kope kūloko.
Ulu ke kope o Kaʻeo ma Kauaʻi?
ʻAe, ulu nā lāʻau kope ma ka ʻāina o kona ʻohana ma Kauaʻi.
ʻEhia kālā ka uku o ke kope?
ʻEhā kālā ka uku o ke kope.
Ua hele wikiwiki ka wahine i kona keʻena?
ʻAe, ua hele wikiwiki ʻo ia.

lessons.title: Ke kelepona hewa
lessons.summary: Flying from Līhuʻe to Honolulu for a holiday, Lokelani takes the wrong phone off the plane and gives it back to its owner.
lessons.text:
Noho ʻo Lokelani ma Līhuʻe ma Kauaʻi. Ua hana nui ʻo ia i kēia makahiki, a makemake ʻo ia e hoʻomaha. E hoʻomaha ana ʻo ia ma Honolulu no ʻeono lā.

Ua lele ka mokulele mai Līhuʻe aku. Ma kahi o 100 mile wale nō mai Kauaʻi a i Oʻahu, no laila ʻaʻole lōʻihi ka huakaʻi. Ma ka mokulele, ua noho ʻo Lokelani ma ka ʻaoʻao o kekahi wahine, ʻo Kiele. Like loa ke kelepona o Lokelani me ke kelepona o Kiele. Ua kau lāua i nā kelepona ʻelua ma kahi hoʻokahi.

Ua pae ka mokulele ma Honolulu. Ua lawe wikiwiki ʻo Lokelani i kekahi kelepona, a ua lele ʻo ia mai ka mokulele.

Ma hope o kekahi manawa pōkole, ua kani ke kelepona. ʻO Kiele ma ke kelepona! Ua lawe ʻo Lokelani i ke kelepona hewa. ʻO ke kelepona o Kiele kēia, a aia nā mea pilikino o Kiele ma loko: nā kiʻi pilikino o kāna mau keiki.

Ua hoʻi ʻo Lokelani i ke kahua mokulele. Ua hoʻihoʻi ʻo ia i ke kelepona o Kiele, a ua hoʻihoʻi ʻo Kiele i ke kelepona o Lokelani. "Mahalo nui," wahi a Kiele. Ma hope, ua hele ʻo Lokelani e hoʻomaha ma Waikīkī.

Nā nīnau:
E hoʻomaha ana ʻo Lokelani ma Honolulu no ʻehia lā?
E hoʻomaha ana ʻo ia ma Honolulu no ʻeono lā.
ʻEhia mile mai Kauaʻi a i Oʻahu?
Ma kahi o 100 mile wale nō.
Ua kani ke kelepona o Kiele?
ʻAe, ua kani ke kelepona, a ʻo Kiele ma ke kelepona.
Ua pae ka mokulele ma Honolulu?
ʻAe, ua pae ka mokulele ma Honolulu.
Ua lawe ʻo Lokelani i ke kelepona hewa?
ʻAe, ua lawe ʻo ia i ke kelepona o Kiele.
Ua hoʻihoʻi ʻo Lokelani i ke kelepona?
ʻAe, ua hoʻihoʻi ʻo ia i ke kelepona o Kiele.

lessons.title: Ka ʻino
lessons.summary: A storm breaks part of the old stone wall in front of Keahi's house in Kalihi; a stone breaks his hand while he repairs it, and his daughter helps him finish.
lessons.text:
He hale kahiko ko Keahi ma Kalihi. Aia kekahi pā pōhaku ma mua o kona hale. Ua kūkulu kona kupuna i ke pā me nā pōhaku o ka ʻāina.

I kekahi lā, ua hiki mai kekahi ʻino nui i Honolulu. Nui loa ka ua, a ua piha nā ala i ka wai. I loko o ka ʻino, ua haʻi kekahi ʻāpana o ke pā pōhaku.

Ma hope o ka ʻino, ua hoʻoponopono ʻo Keahi i ke pā. Ua lawe ʻo ia i nā pōhaku nui, a ua kau ʻo ia iā lākou ma luna o ke pā. Akā, ua hāʻule kekahi pōhaku nui ma luna o kona lima. Ua haʻi kona lima, a ua ʻino ka ʻili o kona lima.

Ua lawe kāna kaikamahine, ʻo Kaʻōnohi, iā ia i ka hale maʻi. Ma laila, ua nānā nā kānaka o ka hale maʻi i kona lima a me kona poʻo. Maikaʻi kona poʻo: ʻaʻole i hāʻule ka pōhaku ma luna o kona poʻo. Ua lapaʻau lākou i kona lima a me kona ʻili. Hana nā kānaka o ka hale maʻi e hoʻōla i nā kānaka maʻi. Ma hope o ka lapaʻau ʻana, ua hoʻi ʻo Keahi i kona hale.

Ma hope o ʻelua mahina, ua hoʻōla ʻia kona lima. Ua kūkulu hou ʻo Keahi lāua ʻo Kaʻōnohi i ke pā pōhaku.

Nā nīnau:
Aia ka hale o Keahi ma Kalihi?
ʻAe, aia kona hale kahiko ma Kalihi.
Ua haʻi ke pā pōhaku i ka ʻino?
ʻAe, ua haʻi kekahi ʻāpana o ke pā i ka ʻino.
Ua hāʻule ka pōhaku ma luna o ke poʻo o Keahi?
ʻAʻole, ua hāʻule ka pōhaku ma luna o kona lima.
Ua lapaʻau ʻia ka lima o Keahi ma ka hale maʻi?
ʻAe, ua lapaʻau ʻia kona lima a me kona ʻili.
Ua kūkulu hou ʻo Keahi i ke pā?
ʻAe, ua kūkulu hou ʻo ia i ke pā me kāna kaikamahine.

lessons.title: Ka nahele ma ka palena
lessons.summary: When a company wants to build houses in the forest at the edge of Honolulu, Kanoe asks a city meeting to protect it, and the meeting agrees.
lessons.text:
Noho ʻo Kanoe ma Mānoa, ma ka palena o ke kūlanakauhale ʻo Honolulu. Aia kekahi nahele kūlohelohe kokoke i kona hale. Ma ka nahele, ulu nā lāʻau kahiko, a noho nā manu he nui.

I kēia makahiki, makemake kekahi hui e kūkulu i nā hale hou ma ka nahele. ʻAʻole makemake ʻo Kanoe a me kona kaiāulu i kēia. No laila, ua kākau ʻo Kanoe i kekahi hoʻopiʻi kūhelu i ke kūlanakauhale.

Ua mālama ʻia kekahi ʻaha ma ke kikowaena kiwikā o Honolulu. ʻO ka nahele ke kumuhana o ka ʻaha. He kumuhana koʻikoʻi kēia no ke kaiāulu, a ua hele nā kānaka he nui i ke kikowaena kiwikā.

Ua kū ʻo Kanoe i mua o ka ʻaha, a ua heluhelu ʻo ia i kāna hoʻopiʻi. "He nahele kūlohelohe kēia," wahi āna. "Aia ka nahele ma ka palena o ke kūlanakauhale. Noi ke kaiāulu i ke kūlanakauhale e hoʻomalu i ka nahele, a e hoʻokaʻawale i ka ʻāina no nā lāʻau a me nā manu." Ua ʻōlelo pū kekahi kanaka o ka hui.

Ma hope, ua koho ka ʻaha. Ua kākau ka ʻaha i kekahi palapala kūhelu: e hoʻokaʻawale ʻia ka ʻāina o ka nahele, a e hoʻomalu ʻia ka nahele e ke kūlanakauhale. Ua maikaʻi loa ka manaʻo o Kanoe.

Nā nīnau:
Noho ʻo Kanoe ma ka palena o ke kūlanakauhale?
ʻAe, noho ʻo ia ma Mānoa, ma ka palena o ke kūlanakauhale.
He nahele kūlohelohe ka nahele kokoke i kona hale?
ʻAe, he nahele kūlohelohe ia.
Ua kākau ʻo Kanoe i ka hoʻopiʻi?
ʻAe, ua kākau ʻo ia i kekahi hoʻopiʻi kūhelu.
Ua mālama ʻia ka ʻaha ma ke kikowaena kiwikā?
ʻAe, ua mālama ʻia ka ʻaha ma ke kikowaena kiwikā o Honolulu.
Ua noi ke kaiāulu e hoʻomalu i ka nahele?
ʻAe, ua noi lākou e hoʻomalu ʻia ka nahele.

lessons.title: Ka huakaʻi mōʻaukala
lessons.summary: Kalehua, a history expert, walks a group around ʻIolani Palace and tells how the kingdom became a republic, a territory and a state.
lessons.text:
He loea ʻo Kalehua no ka mōʻaukala o Hawaiʻi. I kekahi lā, ua alakaʻi ʻo ia i kekahi huakaʻi ma ke kikowaena o Honolulu.

Ua kū lākou ma mua o ka hale aliʻi ʻo ʻIolani. "Ma mua, he kaumokuʻāina kūʻokoʻa ʻo Hawaiʻi," wahi a ka loea. "Ua noho ka mōʻī ma kēia hale. Ua hana nā kuhina o ke aupuni ma kēlā hale ma kēlā ʻaoʻao o ke ala, ʻo Aliʻiōlani Hale. Ua kōkua nā kuhina i ka mōʻī."

"I ka makahiki 1893, ua pau ke aupuni mōʻī. I ka makahiki 1894, ua hoʻokumu ʻia kekahi lepupalika, ʻo ka Lepupalika o Hawaiʻi. I ka makahiki 1898, ua hoʻohui ʻia ʻo Hawaiʻi me ʻAmelika. Ua iho ka hae o Hawaiʻi ma ʻIolani, a ua kau ʻia ka hae ʻAmelika ma laila. I ka makahiki 1900, ua lilo ʻo Hawaiʻi i panalāʻau o ʻAmelika."

"Ma ka panalāʻau, ua alakaʻi ke kiaʻāina i ke aupuni. Aia ka hale o ke kiaʻāina kokoke i ʻIolani. I ka makahiki 1959, ua lilo ka panalāʻau i mokuʻāina. I kēia manawa, ʻaʻole he kaumokuʻāina kūʻokoʻa ʻo Hawaiʻi, akā ke kau nei ka hae o Hawaiʻi ma ʻIolani."

Ma hope, ua hula kekahi mau kānaka ʻōiwi i kekahi hula kuʻuna ma ka pā o ka hale aliʻi. "ʻO ka hula kuʻuna kekahi ʻāpana koʻikoʻi o ka moʻomeheu ʻōiwi," wahi a Kalehua.

Nā nīnau:
He loea ʻo Kalehua no ka mōʻaukala?
ʻAe, he loea ʻo ia no ka mōʻaukala o Hawaiʻi.
He kaumokuʻāina kūʻokoʻa ʻo Hawaiʻi ma mua?
ʻAe, he kaumokuʻāina kūʻokoʻa ʻo Hawaiʻi ma mua.
Ua hoʻokumu ʻia ka lepupalika i ka makahiki 1894?
ʻAe, ua hoʻokumu ʻia ka Lepupalika o Hawaiʻi i ka makahiki 1894.
Ua lilo ʻo Hawaiʻi i panalāʻau i ka makahiki 1900?
ʻAe, ua lilo ʻo Hawaiʻi i panalāʻau o ʻAmelika.
Ua hula nā kānaka ʻōiwi i ka hula kuʻuna?
ʻAe, ua hula lākou ma ka pā o ka hale aliʻi.

lessons.title: Ke kime ʻulaʻula
lessons.summary: On a hot day Hāliʻa's team in red runs three laps before a hard game against a team in white from Waiʻanae, and wins.
lessons.text:
Pāʻani ʻo Hāliʻa i ka pōpō me kekahi kime ma Kapolei. ʻUlaʻula nā lole o kona kime. I kēia lā, e pāʻani ana lākou me kekahi kime mai Waiʻanae mai. Keʻokeʻo nā lole o kēlā kime.

Wela loa ka lā. Ma mua o ka pāʻani ʻana, ua holo ke kime ʻulaʻula ʻekolu puni a puni ke kahua. Ma kahi o hoʻokahi mile ka holo ʻana. Paʻakikī ka holo ʻana i ka lā wela, akā ua hoʻoikaika nā keiki.

He ʻālapa kaulana ka makuahine o Hāliʻa. Ua pāʻani ʻo ia i ka pōpō ma ke kulanui. "E hoʻoikaika!" wahi a ka makuahine. "E nānā i ka pōpō!"

Paʻakikī ka pāʻani. Ikaika ke kime keʻokeʻo. Ma ka hapa mua, ua loaʻa i ke kime keʻokeʻo hoʻokahi helu. Ma ka hapa ʻelua, ua hoʻoikaika hou ke kime ʻulaʻula. Ua holo ʻo Hāliʻa me ka pōpō, a ua loaʻa iā ia hoʻokahi helu. Ma hope, ua loaʻa hou he helu i kekahi kaikamahine o kona kime. Ua kūleʻa ke kime ʻulaʻula: 2 a 1.

"He lā kūleʻa kēia," wahi a ka makuahine. Makemake ʻo Hāliʻa e lilo i ʻālapa e like me kona makuahine.

Nā nīnau:
ʻUlaʻula nā lole o ke kime o Hāliʻa?
ʻAe, ʻulaʻula nā lole o kona kime.
Ua holo ke kime ʻekolu puni a puni ke kahua?
ʻAe, ua holo lākou ʻekolu puni a puni ke kahua.
He ʻālapa ka makuahine o Hāliʻa?
ʻAe, he ʻālapa kaulana ʻo ia.
Ua kūleʻa ke kime ʻulaʻula?
ʻAe, ua kūleʻa lākou, 2 a 1.
Wela ka lā?
ʻAe, wela loa ka lā.

lessons.title: Ke kiʻi ma ke pā
lessons.summary: Kainani, a skilled painter in Wailuku, leads a group of young people in painting flowers and an old woman's face on a long wall.
lessons.text:
He kanaka pena kiʻi ʻo Kainani ma Wailuku. Akamai loa ʻo ia. I kēia makahiki, ua noi ke kaiāulu iā ia e pena i kekahi kiʻi nui ma ke pā lōʻihi o ke kahua pāʻani.

Ua hana ʻo Kainani me kekahi pūʻulu ʻōpio. Ma mua, ua kaha ʻo ia i ke kiʻi ma ke pā. Ma hope, ua kuhikuhi ʻo ia i kēlā me kēia ʻōpio i kekahi ʻāpana o ke kiʻi.

ʻO ka hapa mua o ke kiʻi: nā pua ʻulaʻula a me nā pua keʻokeʻo. Maʻalahi ka pena ʻana i nā pua. Ua hoʻopili ka pūʻulu i nā pōhaku liʻiliʻi ma waena o kēlā me kēia pua. Nani nā pua!

ʻO ka hapa ʻelua: ka maka o kekahi wahine kahiko. ʻAʻole maʻalahi ka pena ʻana i nā hiʻohiʻona o ka maka. Ua kuhikuhi ʻo Kainani i nā hiʻohiʻona a pau. Ua kaha ʻo ia i nā hiʻohiʻona ma mua, a ua pena ka pūʻulu ma hope.

Ma hope o ʻelua mahina, ua pau ke kiʻi. "Nani loa!" wahi a nā kānaka o ke kaiāulu. Ua hoʻopili ʻo Kainani i kekahi palapala liʻiliʻi ma ke pā, me nā inoa o nā ʻōpio a pau.

Nā nīnau:
He kanaka akamai ʻo Kainani?
ʻAe, akamai loa ʻo ia.
Ua hana ʻo Kainani me kekahi pūʻulu ʻōpio?
ʻAe, ua hana ʻo ia me kekahi pūʻulu ʻōpio.
Maʻalahi ka pena ʻana i nā pua?
ʻAe, maʻalahi ka pena ʻana i nā pua.
Maʻalahi ka pena ʻana i nā hiʻohiʻona o ka maka?
ʻAʻole, ʻaʻole maʻalahi ka pena ʻana i nā hiʻohiʻona o ka maka.
Ua hoʻopili ʻo Kainani i kekahi palapala ma ke pā?
ʻAe, ua hoʻopili ʻo ia i kekahi palapala me nā inoa o nā ʻōpio.

lessons.title: Nā ʻuhane o ke kūlanakauhale
lessons.summary: Kahananui leads a night tour about ghosts in downtown Honolulu; the group hears a hymn on an empty street and finds a choir in an old church.
lessons.text:
He alakaʻi huakaʻi ʻo Kahananui ma Honolulu. I kekahi pō, ua alakaʻi ʻo ia i kekahi pūʻulu ma nā ala kahiko o ke kikowaena. ʻO nā ʻuhane ke kumuhana o kāna huakaʻi.

"Aia nā ʻuhane he nui ma ke kūlanakauhale," wahi a Kahananui. "Ma mua o ka hele ʻana, e hoʻomaopopo i nā loina o ka huakaʻi. Mai lawe i nā pōhaku mai nā wahi kapu. Mai komo i nā hale kapu. Inā kani kekahi leo, mai holo!"

Ua hele ka pūʻulu ma ke ala. Ua kū lākou ma mua o kekahi hale kahiko. "He wahi kapu kēia," wahi a Kahananui. "Wahi a ka moʻolelo, hele ka ʻuhane o kekahi aliʻi ma kēia wahi."

Ma hope, ua kani kekahi hīmeni. ʻAʻohe naʻe kanaka ma ke ala. Ua kū nā kānaka a pau. "Inā he ʻuhane kēia, mai holo!" wahi a Kahananui. Ua hele naʻe lākou i ka hale pule kahiko.

Ma loko o ka hale pule, ua hīmeni kekahi hui hīmeni. Ua kamaʻilio ʻo Kahananui me ke alakaʻi o ka hui. "ʻAʻohe ʻuhane ma kēia hale," wahi a ke alakaʻi. "He hui hīmeni mākou. Hīmeni mākou ma kēia hale pule i kēlā me kēia pō." Ua hoʻomaopopo ka pūʻulu. Ua kamaʻilio lākou me ka hui hīmeni, a ua hīmeni pū lākou.

Nā nīnau:
ʻO nā ʻuhane ke kumuhana o ka huakaʻi a Kahananui?
ʻAe, ʻo nā ʻuhane ke kumuhana o kāna huakaʻi.
Hiki i ka pūʻulu ke lawe i nā pōhaku mai nā wahi kapu?
ʻAʻole, he loina kēia: mai lawe i nā pōhaku mai nā wahi kapu.
Aia kekahi kanaka ma ke ala?
ʻAʻole, ʻaʻohe kanaka ma ke ala.
Ua hīmeni nā ʻuhane i loko o ka hale pule?
ʻAʻole, ua hīmeni kekahi hui hīmeni.
Ua hoʻomaopopo ka pūʻulu?
ʻAe, ua hoʻomaopopo lākou, a ua hīmeni pū lākou.

lessons.title: Ka male ʻana o Keikilani
lessons.summary: Keikilani, raised by her grandmother in Kāneʻohe, marries Kaʻula in a big room in Honolulu, with food, music and a carved board from his father.
lessons.text:
Ua hānai ʻia ʻo Keikilani e kona kupuna ma Kāneʻohe. Ua hānai ke kupuna iā ia mai kona wā liʻiliʻi mai. I kēia lā, e male ana ʻo Keikilani iā Kaʻula.

Ua mālama ʻia ka male ʻana ma kekahi lumi nui ma Honolulu. Keʻokeʻo ka lole o Keikilani, a keʻokeʻo nā pua ma ka lumi.

Ua hoʻokipa ka ʻohana o Kaʻula i nā kānaka a pau. Maikaʻi loa ko lākou hoʻokipa. Ma ka puka o ka lumi, ua hāʻawi lākou i nā pūpū. Ua ʻai nā kānaka i nā pūpū ma mua o ka meaʻai nui. Ma hope, ua lawe mai ka ʻohana i ka meaʻai. Ua hana ke kupuna i kekahi ʻāpana o ka meaʻai.

Ua hoʻokani pila kekahi mau hoaaloha o Kaʻula, a ua hula ke kupuna. Ua kālai ka makuakāne o Kaʻula i kekahi papa lāʻau no lāua. Ua kālai ʻo ia i nā inoa o Keikilani lāua ʻo Kaʻula ma ka papa.

Ua kū ʻo Keikilani, a ua ʻōlelo ʻo ia no kona kupuna. Ua hāʻawi ʻo ia i kekahi makana nona: he kiʻi o lāua ʻelua. Ma hope, ua hīmeni ʻo Kaʻula i kekahi mele nona.

Nā nīnau:
Ua hānai ʻia ʻo Keikilani e kona kupuna?
ʻAe, ua hānai ʻia ʻo ia e kona kupuna ma Kāneʻohe.
Ua male ʻo Keikilani iā wai?
Ua male ʻo ia iā Kaʻula.
Ua mālama ʻia ka male ʻana ma kekahi lumi nui?
ʻAe, ma kekahi lumi nui ma Honolulu.
Ua hoʻokani pila nā hoaaloha o Kaʻula?
ʻAe, ua hoʻokani pila lākou.
Ua kālai ka makuakāne o Kaʻula i ka papa lāʻau?
ʻAe, ua kālai ʻo ia i nā inoa ma ka papa.

lessons.title: Ka pele ma Pāhoa
lessons.summary: In 2014 a lava flow comes close to the small town of Pāhoa; experts watch it every day, Kamakea decides to stay, and today he grows plants on the old lava.
lessons.text:
Noho ʻo Kamakea ma Pāhoa, he kūlanakauhale liʻiliʻi ma ka mokupuni ʻo Hawaiʻi. I ka makahiki 2014, ua hele mai kekahi pele mai ka mauna mai. Ua neʻe ka pele i ke kūlanakauhale.

Ua loiloi nā loea i ka pele i kēlā me kēia lā. Ua piʻi lākou i ka mauna, a ua nānā lākou mai kekahi mokulele liʻiliʻi. Wela loa ka pele. Ua piʻi ka wela ma ke kūlanakauhale. Ma hope o ka loiloi ʻana, ua hōʻoia nā loea: ua kokoke ka pele i ke kūlanakauhale.

Ua hoʻoholo kekahi mau ʻohana e haʻalele i Pāhoa. Ua hoʻoholo ʻo Kamakea e noho. Makemake ʻo ia e noho ma kona hale. Ma hope, ua kū ka pele kokoke i ke kūlanakauhale. Ua hōʻoia hou nā loea: ʻaʻole e neʻe hou ana ka pele.

Ua hala nā makahiki he nui. Ua hala ka pilikia. I kēia manawa, ke hoʻoulu nei ʻo Kamakea i nā lāʻau ma ka pele kahiko kokoke i kona hale. Hoʻoulu ʻo ia i nā lāʻau pua a me nā lāʻau kope. Hoʻomanaʻo ʻo Kamakea i ka makahiki 2014. Hoʻomanaʻo pū nā kānaka a pau o Pāhoa i ka pele.

Nā nīnau:
Ua hele mai ka pele i Pāhoa i ka makahiki 2014?
ʻAe, ua hele mai ka pele mai ka mauna mai.
Ua loiloi nā loea i ka pele?
ʻAe, ua loiloi lākou i ka pele i kēlā me kēia lā.
Ua hoʻoholo ʻo Kamakea e haʻalele?
ʻAʻole, ua hoʻoholo ʻo ia e noho.
Ke hoʻoulu nei ʻo Kamakea i nā lāʻau?
ʻAe, ke hoʻoulu nei ʻo ia i nā lāʻau ma ka pele kahiko.
Hoʻomanaʻo ʻo Kamakea i ka makahiki 2014?
ʻAe, hoʻomanaʻo ʻo ia i ka makahiki 2014.
